alive.last_commit_message:
ci(install-smoke): fix PowerShell hunt-reject step exit code + widen paths trigger

The #252 reject assertions worked (hunt correctly refused `../escaped` etc.), but
the `hunt` rejection leaves $LASTEXITCODE=1, so the pwsh step itself exited 1 even
though every assertion passed. Clear $LASTEXITCODE after the checks — the `throw`s,
not the exit code, are what fail the step on a real regression.

Also add scripts/test_hunt_target.sh and the workflow file itself to the push/PR
paths filters, so changes to the hunt reject test (or this workflow) actually
re-run install-smoke instead of silently skipping it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
